book.name: SOHN
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: “I padahkihong kumwail mepwukat pwe kumwail en dehr kesehla amwail pwoson.
Irail pahn keseikumwailla sang nan arail sinakoke kan. Oh ahnsou kohkohdo, mehmen me pahn kemeikumwailla pahn kihkihong me e kin papah Koht.
Irail pahn wiahiong kumwail mepwukat pwehki ar sohte ese Sahm de ngehi.

A I ndaiongkumwailehr mepwukat pwe ni ahnsowo eh pahn leledo pwe re en wia mepwukat, kumwail en tamanda ei koasoi pwukat.” Doadoahk en Ngehn Sarawi “I sohte padahkihong kumwail mepwukat nin tapio, pwehki ei mihmi rehmwail.
A met I pahn kolahng rehn ih me ketin kadariehdo; a sohte mehmen rehmwail me idek rehi, ‘Ia wasa komw pahn ketila ie?’
Ahpw met, pwehki ei ndaiongkumwailehr, pahtou kadirelahr mohngiongimwail kan.
I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: me mwahuwong kumwail ma I pahn kohkohla sang kumwail, pwe ma I sohte pahn kohla, Sounsawaso sohte pahn ketidohng kumwail. A ma I kohla, eri, I pahn kadarodohng kumwail.
Oh ni eh pahn ketido, e ahpw pahn ketin kadehdehiong tohn sampah me irail me sapwung nin duwen dihp, oh duwen dahme pwung, oh duwen kadeik en Koht.
Irail kin sapwung nin duwen dihp, pwehki arail sohte pwoson ie;
oh duwen dahme pwung, pwehki ei kohkolahng rehn Sahm oh kumwail solahr pahn kak kilang ie.
Oh pil duwen kadeik, pwehki kaunen sampah wet pakadeidahr.
“Pil mie me tohto me I men ndaiong kumwail, ahpw met me inenen apwal ong kumwail en wehwehki.

A ni Ngenen mehlelo eh pahn ketido, e pahn ketin kahluwai kumwail ong nan soangen mehlel koaros. E sohte pahn ketin mahsen sang pein ih, ahpw e pahn padahkihong kumwail dahme e kin karonge, oh mahsenki duwen mehkan me pahn kohdo.
E pahn ketin kalinganaiehda, pwe e pahn ale mehkan me I koasoia oh padahkihong kumwail.
Mehkoaros me Semei sapwellimaniki, iei ahi; ihme kahrehda I ndahkihong kumwail me Ngehno pahn ale dahme I kihong oh padahkihong kumwail.”
Pahtou oh Peren
“A mwurin ahnsou kis, kumwail solahr pahn kilang ie, oh pil mwurin ahnsou kis, kumwail pahn pil pwurehng kilang ie.”

Ekei sang nanpwungen sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw peidekpene nanpwungarail, “Ia wehwehn met, me e ketin mahsanihkihong kitail, ‘Mwurin ahnsou kis kumwail solahr pahn kilang ie; oh pil mwurin ahnsou kis kumwail pahn pwurehng kilang ie?’ Oh e pil mahsanih, ‘Pwehki I kohkolahng rehn Semei.’”
Irail ahpw idek, “Ia wehwehn mahsen wet, ‘Mwurin ahnsou kis?’ Kitail sohte wehwehki dahme e mahmahsanih!”

Sises mwahngih duwen arail men kalelapak reh, e ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “I nda, ‘Mwurin ahnsou kis kumwail solahr pahn kilang ie, oh pil mwurin ahnsou kis kumwail pahn pwurehng kilang ie.’ Ia duwe, ih met me kumwail peidengkipene nanpwungamwail?
I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: kumwail pahn sengiseng oh mwahiei, ahpw sampah wet pahn pereperen. Kumwail pahn nsensuwed, ahpw amwail nsensuwed pahn wekiong ni peren.

Ni en lih emen eh pahn kereniong neitik, e pahn nsensuwed, pwehki eh ahnsoun medek lelehr. Ahpw ni ahnsou me serio ipwidier, e pahn manokehla eh medek; e pahn perenda, pwehki seri men ipwidiongehr sampah.
Iei pil duwen kumwail, ahnsou wet kumwail pahtou, ahpw I pahn pwurehng tuhwong kumwail, oh mohngiongimwail kan pahn direkihla peren, soangen peren me sohte emen kak kihsang kumwail.
“Ni rahno eh pahn leledo, kumwail sohte pahn peki rehi mehkot. I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: Sahmo pahn ketikihong kumwail mehkoaros me kumwail pahn peki reh ni edei.
Lao lel ahnsou wet kumwail saikinte peki mehkot ni edei. Kumwail peki, a kumwail pahn ale, pwe amwail peren en unsekla.”
Powehdi Sampah
“I padahkihongkumwailehr mepwukat ni karasaras. A ahnsou pahn kohdo me I solahr pahn doadoahngki karasaras, pwe I pahn koasoiong kumwail ni sansal duwen Semei.
Ni rahno eh pahn leledo, kumwail pahn pein peki mehkan rehn Koht ni edei, oh I sohte pahn koasoia me I pahn peki reh mehkot ong kumwail,
pwe pein Sahmo ketin loalloalei kumwail. E ketin loalloalei kumwail pwehki amwail poakohng ie oh kamehlele me I kohdo sang rehn Koht.
I kohdo sang rehn Sahmo, oh kodohngehr sampah. Eri, met I pahn mweselsangehr sampah oh kolahng rehn Sahmo.”
Eri, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, komw kin mahsen sansal ahnsou wet, oh solahr doadoahngki karasaras.
Met se ese me komw ketin mwahngih soahng koaros, oh komw sohte anahne emen en kalelapak mehkot rehmwi. Met kahrehiong kiht en kamehlele me komw ketido sang rehn Koht.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ia duwe, kumwail pwosonlahr ahnsou wet?
Ahnsowo pahn kohdo, oh e leledohr, me kumwail koaros pahn mwarahkpeseng nan amwail wasa kan; I ahpw pahn kelehpwla. Ahpw I sohte uhdahn pahn kelehpwla, pwe Semei kin ketin ieiang ie.
I padahkihong kumwail mepwukat pwe kumwail en ahneki popohl ni amwail miniminiong ie. Sampah pahn kalokei kumwail, ahpw kumwail koapworopwor, pwehki I kalowehdier sampah!”
